Test build of GE-Proton 11.0-5 for Android (arm64ec) with userspace ntsync and the Material 3 desktop. **Install into a new container.**

## What's new

- **esync can stay on**: ntsync now wins over esync (Winlator's default), so the container no longer hangs at a black desktop. `PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1` brings esync back.
- **ntsync fix**: a wait no longer fails when another thread closes the last handle to the object, and abandoned mutexes are reported.
- **Material 3 desktop**: taskbar, launcher and a settings page (color, light/dark, taskbar).
- **Material 3 programs**: title bars, pill-shaped buttons, scroll bars, menus, Roboto font and icons.
- **Files**: a Material 3 file manager that replaces Winlator's `wfm.exe` (the original is kept as `wfm-winlator.exe`; switch in settings).

## Downloads

- `GE-proton-wine-11.0-5-ntsync-m3-arm64ec-sdk28.wcp.xz`: Winlator CMOD & Ludashi
- `GE-proton-11.0-5-ntsync-m3-arm64ec-sdk28.wcp`: GameNative / Bannerlator / WinNative

`versionName` is `11.0-9-arm64ec` with versionCode 2, so it installs next to the earlier GE-Proton 11.0-5 ntsync build.

## Notes

- An older container won't get Files or the Material controls: create a new one.
- `WINE_TASKBAR_STYLE=xp` or `classic` switches to the other desktop styles; try `PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1` if a game misbehaves.

Based on [The412Banner's GE-Proton 11.0-5 Android port](https://github.com/The412Banner/proton-wine) and [GameNative/ntsync-android](https://github.com/GameNative/ntsync-android).
